info.name: JubeeX Parse API
info.description:
HTTP API for the JubeeX Parse microservice (`src/extraction_review/api.py`).

Use this collection from the application layer. All long-running work returns **202** `{ job_id, poll_url }` — poll `GET /v1/jobs/{{job_id}}` until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

**Recommended frontend flow**
1. `POST /v1/filings/split-petition` — LlamaSplit Main Petition (no classify). Poll → `parts` / `page_span`.
2. `POST /v1/filings/verify-document` — check named PDFs vs split categories. Poll → `{ type: DocumentsVerified, match, documents:[{name, match}] }`.
3. `POST /v1/filings/extract` — parse extract-source slots, LlamaExtract, skip Pinecone. Poll → save **`agent_data_id`** and **`result.parsed_slots`** in your DB.
4. `POST /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}/index` — reuse S3 markdown (unless `edited`), parse the rest, Pinecone, then scrutiny defects. Poll `completed` → `result.report`. If `failed` with `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.`, indexing already happened — retry **only** step 5. Do not re-run index.
5. `POST /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}/scrutiny` — defects-only retry (old API). Use after a failed index poll, or to re-run defects later.

**Auth:** if `JUBEEX_API_KEY` is set, send `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
Do not wrap bodies in `start_event`. Do not send `handler_id`.
Replace example `download_url` values with real HTTPS/S3 URLs.

request.description:
`job_type=split_petition`. Ingests the compiled Main Petition PDF, **skips LlamaClassify**, runs LlamaSplit + slice.

`filing_type` is required.
Poll result: `BundlePrepared` with `parts[]` (`slot_id`, `label`, `page_span`, sliced `file_id`) plus leftover `undefined` pages.
Does not parse, extract, or index.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

request.description:
`job_type=verify_document`. Each PDF is LlamaSplit independently against its filename (`cover_page.pdf` → `cover_page`). Optional explicit `slot_id` wins.

Poll `result` is **only**:
```json
{ "type": "DocumentsVerified", "match": false, "documents": [{ "name": "cover_page.pdf", "match": true }] }
```
Overall `match` is true only if every file matches.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

item.name: 3 Extract only (parse extract sources, no Pinecone)

request.description:
`job_type=extract_only`. Parses **extract-source slots only** (Cover Page, Main Petition, Vakalatnama, AOR’s Certificate, Impugned Order) in `documents[]` send order. Runs LlamaExtract. **Skips Pinecone.** Writes per-slot markdown to S3.

**Persist from the completed poll (your DB):**
- top-level `agent_data_id`
- `result.parsed_slots`
- `result.filing_type`
Do not store markdown; it is already on S3 on the Agent Data record.
Then poll **Get job status** — it copies `agent_data_id` and `parsed_slots` into collection variables.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

response.name: 202 Accepted
response.description: Immediate response. Copy `job_id` and poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.

response.name: Poll completed — GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}
response.description: Persist `agent_data_id`, `result.parsed_slots`, and `result.filing_type` in your DB. Then call index. Markdown is on S3, not in this payload.

request.description:
`job_type=index_parsed`. Always after extract. Path `agent_data_id` is required.

- `edited: false` — reuse S3 markdown for `parsed_slots`, LlamaParse the rest.
- `edited: true` / `"yes"` — re-download and re-parse **every** PDF in this request. Does **not** re-extract.
- Echo `parsed_slots` from extract (or omit to fall back to Agent Data metadata).
- `documents[]` **send order** sets global page numbers. Newly inserted files (index, annexures) shift later pages.
After Pinecone upsert, this job runs the same defect checks as `POST /v1/filings/{agent_data_id}/scrutiny`. Poll until `completed` (`result.report`) or `failed`.
If poll `status` is `failed` and `error` is `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.`, Pinecone already ran — the application layer must retry **only** the old `POST /v1/filings/{agent_data_id}/scrutiny` API. Do not call `/index` again.
Does not change existing `POST /v1/filings` `upload_separate` / `upload_compiled`.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

request.description:
Poll until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

On completed extract: copies `agent_data_id` and `result.parsed_slots` into collection variables for index.
On completed index: `result.report` is the defect report.
On failed index with `error` `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.`: retry **only** `POST /v1/filings/{agent_data_id}/scrutiny`. Do not re-run index.
Verify poll `result`: `{ type, match, documents:[{name, match}] }` only.

item.name: 03 Legacy process filing
item.description: Existing `POST /v1/filings`. Unchanged. Prefer folder 02 for the new frontend flow.

request.description: `job_type=upload_compiled`. Classify (unless filing_type is already a slice catalog), LlamaSplit, slice slot PDFs, then stop. Parse/extract wait for submit or use upload_separate / extract.

`job_type=upload_separate`. Already-split files. Parses all slots, extracts, stores Agent Data, **indexes Pinecone**. Stitches pages in **catalog order** (not send order). Prefer `/v1/filings/extract` + `/index` for the new frontend flow.

request.description: Same poll endpoint for every `kind: process_file` and `kind: scrutiny` job.
Fetches Agent Data. Extracted JSON is in `data`. Org/workspace/user, `parsed_slots`, `document_order`, and parse/layout S3 keys are in `data.metadata`.
Sets Agent Data review status. Allowed: `approved`, `rejected`, `pending_review`.

item.name: 06 Scrutiny
item.description: Defect check against an extracted filing.

request.description:
Runs scrutiny on the extracted Agent Data record. Body is optional (`file_hash`, `file_url`/`download_url`, org/workspace).
Poll Get job status. Report is `result.report`.
Rejected filings return 409.
Use this old API after a failed index job whose `error` is `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.` Do not re-run `/index`.
